findings.title: Migration assumes an embedding category exists
findings.description: When `embed_category` is unset or references a deleted category, the query returns no rows. Accessing `[0]['id']` raises before the fallback executes, blocking migration even on sites that never enabled embedding. Handle empty results before indexing and test default installations.

findings.title: Migrated hosts bypass required normalization
findings.description: The migration inserts legacy values such as `https://example.com` verbatim, bypassing the model’s normalization callback. `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares against only `example.com`, so previously working configurations stop authorizing embeds. Normalize migrated hosts and test scheme-prefixed legacy settings.

findings.title: Host values are interpolated directly into SQL
findings.description: Legacy setting values enter SQL without quoting or binding. An apostrophe can break migration, and SQL content can alter the statement. Use database quoting or parameterized insertion.

findings.title: Accepted port-qualified hosts never match
findings.description: Validation accepts `example.com:8080`, but lookup compares it with `URI(...).host`, which returns `example.com` without the port. Saving this configuration succeeds while embedding remains denied. Apply a consistent port policy during normalization and lookup.

findings.title: Validation rejects valid longer domain suffixes
findings.description: The `{2,5}` suffix restriction rejects valid domains such as `example.technology`. Replace the arbitrary length restriction with appropriate hostname validation and add coverage for longer suffixes.

findings.title: New controller tests do not exercise endpoint behavior
findings.description: The only assertion checks inheritance; the embedding controller spec does the same. Add request coverage for authorization, create/update/delete, invalid input, missing records, and serialized responses. These tests currently cannot detect broken CRUD behavior.
